name: sd3_5_genai_bench
description: sd3_5_genai_bench is a generative-AI evaluation suite that measures a model's ability to produce high-quality outputs across a variety of generative tasks (e.g., open-ended text generation, instruction following, and image generation prompts). It focuses on both fidelity and alignment with instructions, combining automatic metrics where applicable and human judgements for subjective dimensions. The benchmark is intended to assess practical generative capabilities rather than narrow classification performance.
evaluation_method: human_eval (augmented with task-specific automatic metrics such as BLEU/ROUGE for text and FID/IS for images)
reputation: Relatively new and niche, primarily used in early-stage evaluations on Hugging Face with limited broader community adoption so far.
